headline: IMF: Financial guarantees will allow Kyiv to access $1.6 billion
summary: Financial guarantees under the IMF assistance programme reviews will allow Kyiv to access 1.6 billion dollars. The IMF is Ukraine's main multilateral lender under its Extended Fund Facility.
why: The International Monetary Fund provides balance-of-payments support to member countries, and its program reviews unlock external financing that affects sovereign credit and reserves.
